description: Header file implementing non-temporal memory copy functions optimized with SIMD instructions, used for efficient large memory block copying with cache considerations.

methods.name: non_temporal_store_memcpy
methods.description: Performs non-temporal memory copy using SIMD instructions, optimized for aligned and unaligned addresses, with fallback to regular memcpy.

methods.name: non_temporal_store_memcpy_avx
methods.description: Performs non-temporal memory copy using AVX instructions, optimized for aligned and unaligned addresses, with fallback to regular memcpy.
